newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL PETROBRAS SHARE SALE MAKES 580 MLN REAIS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL PETROBRAS SHARE SALE MAKES 580 MLN REAIS.

text.p: RIO DE JANEIRO, Aug 12 (REuter) - BNDESpar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank, has sold in a global offer two billion preference shares of state owned oil and gas company Petrobras in its portfolio for 580 million reais, a BNDESpar director said.

Gabriel Stoliar said the initial global offer of 1.8 billion Petrobras preference shares worth 522 million reais was raised to two billion shares due to demand. Under the global offer, 1.65 billion shares were sold abroad and 350 million in Brazil. The offer included 10.679 million American Depositary Shares worth 100 preference shares.
Stoliar said U.S. investors bought 66 percent of the shares, 17 percent were bought by European and Asian investors and 17 by Brazilians with a slight participation by Argentines.

Credit Suisse First Boston coordinated the global offer, with Brazil's Banco Bozano, Simonsen and Itau Bankers Trust overseeing the share offer in Brazil. In May, BNDESpar carried out a similar offer with the sale of one billion Petrobras preference shares for 240.99 million reais. ((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
